psalm-69-1.verse: Save me, O God, For the waters have threatened my life.
psalm-69-1.prayer: Lord, save me when I feel overwhelmed and surrounded by trouble. Lift me above the waters and keep my heart anchored in You.

psalm-69-2.verse: I have sunk in deep mire, and there is no foothold; I have come into deep waters, and a flood overflows me.
psalm-69-2.prayer: Father, when I feel stuck in deep places and unable to stand, place my feet on solid ground and strengthen my faith.

psalm-69-3.verse: I am weary with my crying; my throat is parched; My eyes fail while I wait for my God.
psalm-69-3.prayer: Lord, when I grow weary from crying out and waiting, renew my strength and remind me that You hear me.

psalm-69-4.verse: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; Those who would destroy me are powerful, being wrongfully my enemies; What I did not steal, I then have to restore.
psalm-69-4.prayer: Father, when I face opposition I do not understand, help me respond with faith, patience, and trust in Your justice.

psalm-69-5.verse: O God, it is You who knows my folly, And my wrongs are not hidden from You.
psalm-69-5.prayer: Lord, You know my foolishness and every hidden weakness. Search me, forgive me, and lead me into wisdom and humility.

psalm-69-6.verse: May those who wait for You not be ashamed through me, O Lord God of hosts; May those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
psalm-69-6.prayer: Father, do not let my life bring shame to those who hope in You. Help me live faithfully and honor Your name.

psalm-69-7.verse: Because for Your sake I have borne reproach; Dishonor has covered my face.
psalm-69-7.prayer: Lord, when following You brings rejection or misunderstanding, strengthen me to endure with love and obedience.

psalm-69-8.verse: I have become estranged from my brothers And an alien to my mother's sons.
psalm-69-8.prayer: Father, when I feel alone or distant from others, remind me that I am fully known and loved by You.

psalm-69-9.verse: For zeal for Your house has consumed me, And the reproaches of those who reproach You have fallen on me.
psalm-69-9.prayer: Lord, give me zeal for Your house and Your glory. Let my heart be devoted to what honors You.

psalm-69-10.verse: When I wept in my soul with fasting, It became my reproach.
psalm-69-10.prayer: Father, when humility or obedience is misunderstood, help me remain faithful to You rather than seeking human approval.

psalm-69-11.verse: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
psalm-69-11.prayer: Lord, teach me to endure ridicule or criticism with grace, keeping my eyes fixed on You.

psalm-69-12.verse: Those who sit in the gate talk about me, And I am the song of the drunkards.
psalm-69-12.prayer: Father, when others speak against me, help me rest in Your truth and remember that Your voice matters most.

psalm-69-13.verse: But as for me, my prayer is to You, O Lord, at an acceptable time; O God, in the greatness of Your lovingkindness, Answer me with Your saving truth.
psalm-69-13.prayer: Lord, I pray to You in an acceptable time. Answer me according to Your abundant lovingkindness and saving truth.

psalm-69-14.verse: Deliver me from the mire and do not let me sink; May I be delivered from my foes and from the deep waters.
psalm-69-14.prayer: Father, deliver me from sinking under fear, shame, or discouragement. Rescue me from anything that pulls me away from You.

psalm-69-15.verse: May the flood of water not overflow me Nor the deep swallow me up, Nor the pit shut its mouth on me.
psalm-69-15.prayer: Lord, do not let the flood overwhelm me. Keep me from being swallowed by despair and surround me with Your mercy.

psalm-69-16.verse: Answer me, O Lord, for Your lovingkindness is good; According to the greatness of Your compassion, turn to me,
psalm-69-16.prayer: Father, answer me because Your lovingkindness is good. Turn to me with compassion and renew my hope.

psalm-69-17.verse: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, For I am in distress; answer me quickly.
psalm-69-17.prayer: Lord, do not hide Your face from me in my distress. Draw near quickly and comfort my heart.

psalm-69-18.verse: Oh draw near to my soul and redeem it; Ransom me because of my enemies!
psalm-69-18.prayer: Father, draw near to my soul and redeem me. Rescue me by Your grace and restore my peace.

psalm-69-19.verse: You know my reproach and my shame and my dishonor; All my adversaries are before You.
psalm-69-19.prayer: Lord, You know every reproach, shame, and burden I carry. Help me bring my pain honestly before You.

psalm-69-20.verse: Reproach has broken my heart and I am so sick. And I looked for sympathy, but there was none, And for comforters, but I found none.
psalm-69-20.prayer: Father, when my heart feels broken and comfort feels far away, be my healer, companion, and source of strength.

psalm-69-21.verse: They also gave me gall for my food And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
psalm-69-21.prayer: Lord, when bitterness or disappointment comes near, protect my heart and help me receive the comfort only You can give.

psalm-69-22.verse: May their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, may it become a trap.
psalm-69-22.prayer: Father, remove anything that becomes a snare in my life. Help me recognize danger and walk in wisdom.

psalm-69-23.verse: May their eyes grow dim so that they cannot see, And make their loins shake continually.
psalm-69-23.prayer: Lord, open my eyes to truth and keep me from spiritual blindness. Strengthen me to walk uprightly before You.

psalm-69-24.verse: Pour out Your indignation on them, And may Your burning anger overtake them.
psalm-69-24.prayer: Father, I trust Your justice. Help me leave judgment in Your hands and walk humbly before You.

psalm-69-25.verse: May their camp be desolate; May none dwell in their tents.
psalm-69-25.prayer: Lord, let every place of emptiness in my life be restored by Your presence, mercy, and purpose.

psalm-69-26.verse: For they have persecuted him whom You Yourself have smitten, And they tell of the pain of those whom You have wounded.
psalm-69-26.prayer: Father, give me compassion for those who are wounded. Help me never add pain to someone You are healing.

psalm-69-27.verse: Add iniquity to their iniquity, And may they not come into Your righteousness.
psalm-69-27.prayer: Lord, protect me from hardening my heart. Lead me away from sin and deeper into righteousness.

psalm-69-28.verse: May they be blotted out of the book of life And may they not be recorded with the righteous.
psalm-69-28.prayer: Father, help me live in a way that honors the life You have given me and keeps my name rooted in Your grace.

psalm-69-29.verse: But I am afflicted and in pain; May Your salvation, O God, set me securely on high.
psalm-69-29.prayer: Lord, when I am afflicted or in pain, let Your salvation lift me up and restore my hope.

psalm-69-30.verse: I will praise the name of God with song And magnify Him with thanksgiving.
psalm-69-30.prayer: Father, I will praise Your name with song and magnify You with thanksgiving. Fill my heart with worship.

psalm-69-31.verse: And it will please the Lord better than an ox Or a young bull with horns and hoofs.
psalm-69-31.prayer: Lord, let my praise and gratitude be pleasing to You. May my worship come from a sincere and surrendered heart.

psalm-69-32.verse: The humble have seen it and are glad; You who seek God, let your heart revive.
psalm-69-32.prayer: Father, encourage the humble and those who seek You. Let their hearts be revived by Your goodness.

psalm-69-33.verse: For the Lord hears the needy And does not despise His who are prisoners.
psalm-69-33.prayer: Lord, thank You for hearing the needy and not despising those who are bound or broken. Let Your mercy bring freedom.

psalm-69-34.verse: Let heaven and earth praise Him, The seas and everything that moves in them.
psalm-69-34.prayer: Father, let heaven, earth, and all creation praise You. Help my life join that worship with joy and faithfulness.

psalm-69-35.verse: For God will save Zion and build the cities of Judah, That they may dwell there and possess it.
psalm-69-35.prayer: Lord, save and restore Your people. Build what is broken and establish what belongs to You.

psalm-69-36.verse: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, And those who love His name will dwell in it.
psalm-69-36.prayer: Father, thank You for the inheritance You give to those who love Your name. Help me dwell faithfully in Your promises.

psalm-69-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for hearing me when I am overwhelmed, weary, or brokenhearted. Rescue me from despair, restore my hope, and keep my heart faithful to You. Teach me to endure hardship with humility, trust Your justice, and praise Your name with gratitude. May my life be rooted in Your mercy, lifted by Your salvation, and devoted to Your glory.

In Jesus' name, Amen. 🙏🏻
